title: Flat bottom homology and a bottom truncation arrow
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $D\in D(\mathcal O_T)$ [def-pc-derived-category], and $a\in\mathbf Z$. Choose derived categories for all schemes in one localization universe. Suppose every point of $T$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ and a bounded-above cochain complex $K$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] of finite free modules [def-weil-pbc-free-module], zero in every degree below $a$, with $d^a=0$, together with $L(U\hookrightarrow T)^*D\cong Q(K)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Then $H^a(D)$ is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and there exists an arrow from the single complex $H^a(D)[-a]$ to $D$ inducing an isomorphism on $H^a$.

source.place: Zero-matrix chart argument and pullback clause; standard truncation

proof.text: Use exact derived open restriction and the homology factorization of Q to identify the restriction of bottom homology with H^a(K). The short-complex homology isomorphism for two zero differentials identifies this with K^a. Taking finite-free isomorphisms and the point-indexed open cover gives finite local freeness using Modules.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_restrict_iso_free.
Tensoring with the finite locally free bottom sheaf preserves finite limits and colimits. Symmetry identifies left and right tensoring, proving IsFlat.

For each i<a exact open restriction identifies the local cohomology with H^i(K), which is zero since K^i is zero. Modules.isZero_of_iSup_eq_top proves global vanishing. Apply DerivedCategory.isGE_iff and exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isGE to obtain a strictly >=a representative K. Its smart truncation P=K.truncLE a has only degree-a cohomology. The map Q(P) -> D induced by the truncation inclusion is invertible on H^a by quasiIsoAt_iff_isIso_homologyMap and homologyFunctorFactors naturality. Use exists_iso_singleFunctor_obj_of_isGE_of_isLE to identify Q(P) with N[-a], identify N with H^a(D) through that map, and conjugate to obtain the required arrow.

lean.statement:
theorem localZeroBottomModel_truncation
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (D : schemeDerivedCategory T) (a : ℤ)
    (hmodel :
      ∀ t : T, ∃ U : T.Opens, t ∈ U ∧
      ∃ K : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
        (∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero (K.X i)) ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, i < a → IsZero (K.X i)) ∧ K.d a (a + 1) = 0 ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (K.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
          (R := moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)))) ∧
        Nonempty ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj D ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj K))
:
    SheafOfModules.IsFlat ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) a).obj D) ∧
    ∃ f : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) a).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) a).obj D) ⟶ D,
      IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) a).map f)
